lead: Tobacco, nicotine, cannabis and other smokable or chewable plant products with the gear used to smoke, vape and store them, organised by product family (cigars, pipes, cigarettes, vaping, smokeless, shisha, cannabis, herbal), with house → line → vitola for cigars and maker → shape for pipes.

depts.note: Organised house → line → vitola → edition; vitola (shape and size) is an attribute, not a kind.

b.v: 95–100 classic > 90–94 outstanding > 85–89 very good > below 85
b.w: Cigar Aficionado blind panel scores (appearance and construction, draw and burn, flavour, overall impression).

b.v: totalmente a mano (long filler) > hand-finished > machine-made (short filler)
b.w: Handmade long-filler cigars are the premium class; Habanos labels state 'Totalmente a mano'.

b.v: Habanos warranty seal, hologram band and box codes present > missing
b.w: Counterfeit Cuban cigars are common; the green government warranty seal and box codes are the check.

b.v: claro, colorado claro, colorado, colorado maduro, maduro, oscuro (a choice)
b.w: Shops and makers sort cigars by wrapper colour and by origin of wrapper, binder and filler.
Shape and size set the smoking time and character; a choice, not a ladder.

b.v: box-aged in a humidor at about 65–70 % RH > dry or unknown storage
b.w: Humidor storage keeps cigars smokable; aged boxes of Habanos are sought after.

s.brief: One kind holding the Habanos houses as archetypes by LINE (e.g. Cohiba Línea Clásica, Siglo, Maduro 5, Behike; Montecristo No. 2 / Línea 1935 / Open; Partagás Serie D No. 4 and Serie P; H. Upmann Magnum; Romeo y Julieta Churchill; Hoyo de Monterrey Epicure; Bolívar; Punch; Trinidad; Cuaba; Ramón Allones; San Cristóbal; Juan López; Quai d'Orsay; Vegas Robaina; Por Larrañaga; Sancho Panza; Rafael González; Diplomáticos; El Rey del Mundo; Vegueros; José L. Piedra). Versions = vitolas and Edición Limitada / Edición Regional / Reserva / Gran Reserva releases. The old vitola kinds (robusto, toro, corona, Churchill, corona gorda, petit corona, panatela, double corona, gordo, lancero, Lonsdale, torpedo, belicoso, perfecto, diadema, culebra) become `t` types (parejos and figurados) with their sizes in the definition; their existing models (Cohiba Robusto/Lanceros, Romeo y Julieta, Punch, Por Larrañaga, Rafael González, Bolívar, Sancho Panza, Cuaba Salomones) become versions. Brand-register entries for each house (Habanos S.A., factory, founding). Add a tradition entry for Cuban cigar rolling (Vuelta Abajo, torcedores). Sources: Habanos S.A. site, Cigar Aficionado, Wikipedia house articles.

k.brief: Vitola kinds dissolve into `t`; archetypes are house lines ordered by significance (Cohiba, Montecristo, Partagás, H. Upmann, Romeo y Julieta, Hoyo de Monterrey first).

s.brief: Non-Cuban handmade cigars by country of manufacture; archetypes are named lines with the house as mk: Arturo Fuente (Hemingway, OpusX, Don Carlos), Davidoff (Millennium, Winston Churchill, Aniversario), La Flor Dominicana, Ashton, E.P. Carrillo; Padrón (1964 Anniversary, 1926 Serie), My Father, Oliva (Serie V), Joya de Nicaragua, Drew Estate (Liga Privada, Undercrown), AJ Fernández, Perdomo, Tatuaje; Camacho, Rocky Patel, Alec Bradley, CAO; Mexican San Andrés (Te-Amo) and Brazilian (Dannemann) leaf. Versions = vitolas and limited releases; Cigar Aficionado Top 25 placements in `d` where retrieved. Brand-register entries for each house.

Mass-market and small formats. Cigarillo archetypes: Café Crème, Davidoff Mini, Cohiba Club/Mini, Partagás Mini, Villiger. Little cigar: filtered cigarette-sized cigars (Black & Mild if retrieved, Swisher). Machine-made cigar: Swisher Sweets, Dutch Masters, Backwoods, Phillies, dry-cured European (Agio, Villiger, Dannemann). Toscano: Italian Kentucky fire-cured cigar (Toscano Originale, Antico). Cheroot: open-ended untapered cigars (Burmese, Swiss stumpen). Trim to market-covering lines.

Cigar keeping and cutting. Humidor: types cabinet, desktop, travel; archetypes for Spanish-cedar box makers (Elie Bleu, Davidoff, Adorini, Cigar Caddy as kept). Cutter: types guillotine, double guillotine, punch, V-cut, scissors (old 'models' become types); archetypes Xikar Xi, Les Fines Lames Le Petit, S.T. Dupont, Davidoff. Case: leather/metal tube cases. Add humidification (Boveda two-way packs, crystal gel, active humidifiers) and hygrometers (analogue, digital). Trim adorini SKU list.

depts.note: Pipes by material, with classic shapes as archetypes and makers' shape numbers as versions; pipe tobacco by blend family, with blenders and named blends as archetypes.

b.v: plateau (burl edge) > ebauchon; straight grain > birdseye/flame > cross grain (a value cue)
b.w: Briar from the outer burl is denser and grains better; grain drives price but not smoking quality.

b.v: top grade in each maker's ladder; never compared across makers
b.w: Dunhill, Castello, Stanwell and others grade their own pipes by letter, star or name.

b.v: centred airway meeting the chamber floor, snug tenon > off-centre
b.w: Airway drilling decides how a pipe draws and burns.

b.v: briar; meerschaum; corn cob; clay; morta (a choice)
b.w: Material sets weight, colouring and price.

b.v: Virginia; Virginia/Perique; Burley; English/Balkan; Oriental; Aromatic (a choice)
b.w: Blends are chosen by family first, then by blender.

b.v: higher average with many reviews > few reviews
b.w: TobaccoReviews and retailer ratings rank blends within a family.

b.v: current > discontinued (cellared tins can rise in value)
b.w: Discontinued blends are tracked and cellared by collectors.

s.brief: Maker → shape. Briar pipe archetypes = classic shapes (billiard, apple, bulldog, Rhodesian, Dublin, Canadian, Liverpool, Lovat, Lumberman, poker, Prince, pot, brandy, churchwarden, cavalier, vest-pocket) ordered by significance; old shape 'models' fold in as archetypes or versions; versions are named makers' shape references (Dunhill, Peterson System and Sherlock Holmes, Savinelli 320 KS, Castello, Stanwell, Comoy's, Charatan, Barling, Ser Jacopo). Freehand: Danish freehand school (Sixten Ivarsson, Lars Ivarsson, Bo Nordh, Former, Tom Eltang, W.Ø. Larsen) plus old freehand forms (blowfish, volcano, tomahawk…). Meerschaum: Turkish (Eskişehir) carved figurals, block vs pressed. Corn cob: Missouri Meerschaum (Legend, MacArthur). Clay: Dutch Gouda / English churchwarden clays. Calabash (gourd with meerschaum cup; briar calabash). Tyrolean/Gesteckpfeife, kiseru (Japanese), midwakh (Arabian dokha pipe). Brand-register entries for core makers; tradition entries: Saint-Claude briar, Danish freehand, Eskişehir meerschaum, Japanese kiseru.

k.brief: Old shape kinds (billiard, bulldog, Canadian, apple, Dublin, cavalier, sitter/poker, vest pocket) become archetypes.

s.brief: By blend family; archetypes are blenders' named blends (mk = blender): Dunhill/Peterson Early Morning Pipe and My Mixture 965, Samuel Gawith Full Virginia Flake, Gawith Hoggarth, Mac Baren, Orlik Golden Sliced, Cornell & Diehl (keep old), G.L. Pease, McClelland, Sutliff, Lane, Erinmore, Captain Black, Prince Albert, Escudo, Three Nuns, Presbyterian Mixture. Cut (ribbon, flake, plug, rope, coin, cube) and tin size are `t`/detail, not kinds. Add Oriental/Turkish-led blends. Kizami (Japanese fine-cut for kiseru) and dokha (Arabian midwakh tobacco) are regional kinds here. Trim the Cornell & Diehl skew to a balanced spread of blenders.

Small accessories, restraint mostly. Tamper: types pipe nail, three-in-one (Czech) tool, decorative tamper. Cleaner: types bristle, fluffy, tapered. Filter: types 9 mm charcoal, 6 mm balsa, paper. Stand/rack. Tobacco pouch: types roll-up, pipe-combo, leather. Add pipe reamer (Castleford, Senior), tobacco jar / cellaring jar, and pipe case & bag. Few archetypes needed beyond a couple of named tools.

depts.note: Manufactured cigarettes chosen by brand (tier); rolling papers and kretek explored by enthusiasts (variety).

b.v: king size; regular; slims; superslims; filter or plain (a choice)
b.w: Length, gauge and filter are attributes of one kind.

b.v: ultra-thin rice/hemp > standard wood pulp (a choice)
b.w: Paper weight and burn rate are what rolling-paper makers compete on.

b.v: duty-paid, health-warning pack > unmarked
b.w: Duty stamps and pack warnings mark legal stock.

s.brief: Merge filtered and plain into one manufactured-cigarette kind with `t` (filtered, plain/unfiltered, menthol, slims). Archetypes = historic brand families with mk = maker (Marlboro, Camel, Lucky Strike, Gauloises, Gitanes, Benson & Hedges, Dunhill, Sobranie Black Russian, Peace, Seven Stars, Nat Sherman, American Spirit), versions = key variants. Kretek: Dji Sam Soe, Gudang Garam, Djarum, Sampoerna A Mild (keep old ranges); add an Indonesian kretek tradition entry. Bidi: Indian beedi (tendu leaf). Roll-your-own: fine-cut and make-your-own (MYO) as `t`; archetypes Drum, Golden Virginia, Amber Leaf, Old Holborn, Samson. Brand entries for the big tobacco groups only.

Rolling paper: archetypes by brand family (Rizla, Zig-Zag, OCB, RAW, Smoking, Gizeh, JOB, Bambú, Elements), with sizes (single wide, 1¼, king size slim) and blunt wraps as `t`; cut the RAW/OCB SKU list to one archetype per brand with a few versions. Rolling machine: types hand roller, rollbox, tube-filling. Cigarette tube and tube injector kept separate. Filter tip: types card roach, cotton/foam filter, glass tip. Rolling tray: restraint.

depts.note: Tier for everyday kits, e-liquids and heated tobacco; variety at the enthusiast end (rebuildable atomisers, mods).

b.v: mouth-to-lung (MTL); restricted direct-to-lung (RDL); direct-to-lung (DTL) (a choice)
b.w: Kit, coil resistance and e-liquid type are matched to the draw wanted.

b.v: regulated chipset with protections > unregulated (mechanical) for experts only
b.w: Regulated mods cut out on short circuits; mechanical mods need battery knowledge.

b.v: authentic named cells (Samsung, Sony/Murata, Molicel, LG) at rated continuous current > rewrapped cells
b.w: Battery rating mismatches are the main vaping hazard.

b.v: freebase vs nicotine salt; mg/ml (a choice)
b.w: Nic salts suit low-power pod kits, freebase suits higher-power kits.

b.v: TPD/PMTA-compliant, registered product > unregistered or illicit
b.w: Illicit disposables exceed tank and nicotine limits.

s.brief: Tier at the kit end (disposables, pod kits, pens: keep 5–10 market-covering models such as SKE Crystal, Elf Bar, JUUL, OXVA Xlim, Vaporesso XROS, VooPoo Argus, Uwell Caliburn, SMOK Novo); variety at the enthusiast end. Box mod archetypes: DNA-chip mods (Evolv DNA), Dicodes, SX Mini, Lost Vape Centaurus, Geekvape Aegis. Add mechanical mods (tube and box mechs; Kennedy, Avid Lyfe if retrieved) and squonk (bottom-feeder) mods. Types for box mods: single/dual battery, regulated/temperature control. Drop wholesale SKU noise.

Enthusiast core: rebuildable tank atomiser (RTA: Kayfun, Taifun, Dvarw, Zeus as retrieved), rebuildable dripping atomiser (RDA: Goon, Drop Dead), RDTA. Vape tank: types MTL clearomiser, sub-ohm tank. Coil: prebuilt replacement coils by type (mesh, ceramic). Add coil-building supplies (wire such as Kanthal/nichrome/stainless, Clapton builds, wicking cotton, coil jigs) as one kind. Batteries: keep pen battery (510 thread), add vape battery cell (18650/20700/21700 as `t`, chargers in definition). Refillable pod: restraint.

Restraint: e-liquid keeps freebase / nic-salt / zero-nicotine as `t`, add shortfill as a type if in old data notes; prefilled pod keeps SKE Crystal range. Give e-liquid an existing old source or leave s empty only if none.

Restraint: merge capsule-type heated product into the heated-tobacco device as a `t` (stick-heating, capsule-type); keep IQOS ILUMA family, IQOS Original, Ploom and JT 'with' as models (≤8); heating sticks keep TEREA and LEVIA ranges.

depts.note: Tier for nicotine pouches; variety for Swedish snus and nasal snuff, which have enthusiast followings.

b.v: mg per pouch or per gram (a choice)
b.w: Strength is matched to the user, not a quality ladder.

b.v: original (moist) vs white (dry) portion; normal, slim, mini (a choice)
b.w: Snus makers sell each blend in several formats.
Snus sale is banned in the EU outside Sweden; pouches and chew are regulated by country.

s.brief: Swedish snus as a tradition entry (Göteborgs Rapé, General, Ettan, Grovsnus, Röda Lacket; Swedish Match). Portion snus: keep original/white `t`; archetypes General, Göteborgs Rapé, Ettan, Catch, Siberia. Loose snus: Ettan Lös, Grovsnus. Nicotine pouch: tier, Zyn, Velo, Nordic Spirit, On! as market-covering brands. Merge nicotine pearl, dissolvable tobacco and nicotine toothpick into one dissolvable kind with `t`; drop the obsolete brand list to Camel Orbs only if retrieved.

Nasal snuff (rename 'Dry snuff'): English and German snuff makers as archetypes (Wilsons of Sharrow, Fribourg & Treyer, Gawith Apricot, Pöschl Gletscherprise, Bernard); American dry snuff (Tube Rose, Peach Sweet, Carhart's) kept as versions or a type. Moist snuff: Copenhagen, Skoal, Grizzly (keep ranges). Chewing tobacco: types loose leaf, plug, twist; trim the 12-brand list to market-covering ones (Red Man, Beech-Nut, Levi Garrett, Stoker's) plus the German Kautabak sticks kept. Snuff box: period antiques (gold, silver, enamel) — period is an attribute. Add Chinese snuff bottle (glass, porcelain, jade, inside-painted) with a tradition entry.

depts.note: Hookahs by tradition and maker; shisha by style and brand; parts swapped by enthusiasts.

b.v: stainless steel or solid brass stem with good seals > thin plated stems
b.w: Stem material and seals decide longevity and draw.

b.v: classic mu'assel (Egyptian/Gulf); blonde-leaf American; dark-leaf Russian; unflavoured tumbak (a choice)
b.w: Shisha is chosen by style first, then by brand and flavour.

b.v: HMD or quality coconut cubes > quick-light coals
b.w: Quick-light coals add taste and fumes; natural cubes and HMDs give steady heat.

s.brief: Hookah archetypes by tradition and maker: Egyptian (Khalil Mamoon), Syrian, Turkish nargile, Persian ghalyan, Indian huqqa (Bidri bases), Russian stainless (Alpha Hookah, Maklaud), German (Steamulation, Dschinni, Aladin), US (Starbuzz), Kaloud Krysalis (keep). Malabar hookah if retrieved. Shisha tobacco archetypes by brand and style: Nakhla, Al Fakher, Afzal, Starbuzz, Fumari, Tangiers, Adalya, Darkside, MustHave. Add tumbak (unflavoured Persian/Turkish pressed leaf for the nargile). Tobacco-free shisha: types herbal/sugarcane molasses, steam stones. Tradition entries: Egyptian/Levantine shisha, Turkish nargile, Persian ghalyan, Indian huqqa and Bidriware.

Bowl: types Egyptian, Turkish/funnel, phunnel, vortex, silicone; archetypes Kaloud Samsaris (keep) and a classic Egyptian clay bowl. Charcoal: types natural coconut cubes, quick-light; archetypes CocoNara, CocoUrth/Titanium if retrieved. HMD: Kaloud Lotus (originator), Provost. Merge tongs and windcover (plus electric coal burner as a type). Hose: types washable silicone, leather/traditional. Merge diffuser and grommet into one spare-parts kind (grommets, diffusers, downstems, base gaskets). Mouth tips and molasses catcher kept.

depts.note: Collector lighters (variety) beside everyday lighters, ashtrays and cases.

b.v: flint-wheel petrol; flint/piezo butane soft flame; jet/torch; electric arc (a choice)
b.w: Pipe and cigar smokers need different flames.

b.v: dated originals and limited editions in working order > later reissues
b.w: Zippo date codes and Dunhill/Dupont serials date collectible lighters.

b.v: refillable with spare flints/parts > disposable
b.w: Serviceable lighters last decades.

s.brief: Pocket lighter archetypes: Zippo windproof (originator 1933; date codes), Dunhill Rollagas and Unique, S.T. Dupont Ligne 2, Ronson (Banjo, Varaflame), Colibri, IMCO, Bic and Clipper (tier everyday), Cricket. Table lighter: Ronson Queen Anne/Touch-tip, Dunhill Aquarium, Colibri (keep). Pipe lighter: IM Corona Old Boy (keep), Brebbia, Colibri Pacific Air. Cigar lighter: types jet/torch, multi-jet, soft flame; Xikar, Colibri, S.T. Dupont Maxijet. Add electric (arc/plasma, USB) lighter. Merge lighter fuel, flints and wicks into one consumables kind with `t`. Brand-register entries for core lighter makers. Trim Colibri skew.

Design and period pieces: ashtray archetypes (Arne Jacobsen Cylinda-Line, Elie Bleu, cigar ashtrays, pocket ashtray as type, period/advertising ashtrays as a period attribute). Cigarette case: types metal, leather; period archetypes (Art Deco enamel, silver; Fabergé if retrieved) — drop the Guy Janot/Jean Claude SKU noise unless sourced. Cigarette holder: types short, long (opera), filter holder; Denicotea if retrieved.

depts.note: Neutral and shallow: products by form, with forms of the same thing merged into types; glass and vaporisers have an enthusiast end.

b.m: Independent lab certificate of analysis for the batch
b.v: batch certificate > no certificate (a refused certificate is a red flag)
b.w: The certificate shows THC and CBD strength and tests for pesticides, residual solvents, microbes, heavy metals and moisture.

b.v: licensed/regulated product > unregulated
b.w: Legality varies by country and state; licensed products carry tested labels.
Read after the certificate; a choice.

s.brief: Restraint: merge hashish and ice-water hash (types dry-sift, hand-rubbed charas, ice-water/bubble hash); merge shatter, badder/wax and live resin into one solvent-extract kind with texture types (shatter, badder, crumble, sauce, live resin); pre-roll keeps plain/infused types; the prefilled vape cartridge moves here as a 510 cartridge holding a cannabinoid or nicotine oil. No strain lists.

Restraint: dissolve the 'Other edibles' catch-all; merge it with gummies and chocolate into one edible kind (types gummy, chocolate, baked good, mint, hard candy). Keep drink, tincture, capsule, topical; definitions neutral (cannabinoid or other plant extract).

Enthusiast end. Bong: types beaker, straight tube, bubbler, percolator; archetypes ROOR (originator of scientific glass), Illadelph, Mobius, and heady/art glass as a scene; trim the Cheech and Chong SKU list. Dab rig: types recycler, mini rig. Hand pipe & chillum: spoon, sherlock, steamroller, one-hitter/dugout, Indian chillum (tradition). Merge bong bowl and dab nail into one water-pipe parts kind (bowl slide, downstem, ash catcher, quartz banger, carb cap). Grinder: Santa Cruz Shredder, Space Case, 7pipe kept. Vaporisers: merge 'Other vaporizers' into desktop (Volcano Classic/Hybrid, Plenty); portable: Storz & Bickel Mighty+/Crafty+/Venty, PAX, Arizer, DynaVap (butane-heated) as retrieved. Add electronic dab rig (Puffco Peak originator).

depts.note: Neutral and shallow: chewed, smoked or brewed plant products other than tobacco and cannabis.

b.w: Several of these are controlled in many countries; listed for completeness, not endorsement.

s.brief: Restraint: merge areca nut and betel quid (types plain nut, betel quid/paan, gutkha-style mixtures if in old text); khat keeps miraa/muguka as `t` (not models). Kratom kind covers powder, leaf, capsules and shots as types. Keep definitions neutral and short.
